status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY CARRIAGE NUMBER WAS COMPUTED
claim_under_test: A determinant-based decoder predicts MECHANISM PRESENCE (wild-type vs non-wild-type), not treatment outcome (S/I/R). If the EUCAST WGS subcommittee's position is right for this decoder, then among isolates the CLINICAL breakpoint calls susceptible, the ones the ECOFF calls NON-WILD-TYPE should carry the decoder's own determinants MORE OFTEN than the ones it calls wild-type.
why_the_mechanism_analysis_came_first: Two acceptance bars earlier in this project were mis-specified because a threshold was frozen before the analysis that says what a correct result can look like. So the substrate, the determinant definition and the strata were all measured BEFORE this file was written -- only the VERDICT RULE is frozen, and it is frozen on a self-calibrating control rather than on a number I would have had no basis to pick.

substrate_measured_before_freezing.join: MIC guuid -> AMRFinder Name; 2,893 of 2,897 MIC isolates have an AMRFinder run
substrate_measured_before_freezing.why_only_one: ciprofloxacin and ceftriaxone returned DEGENERATE_ECOFF_BELOW_PANEL (ECOFF 0.06 vs panel floor 0.125; 0.125 vs 0.5) so 100% of isolates are non-wild-type and the anchor cannot discriminate; tetracycline has no MIC column in the deposit (wiki/ecoff_tiering_feasibility_2026-09-11.json).
substrate_measured_before_freezing.discriminating_stratum: clinically-S AND above the ECOFF = MIC 4 = 25 isolates
substrate_measured_before_freezing.comparison_stratum: clinically-S AND at/below the ECOFF = MIC 1 or 2 = about 2,656 isolates
substrate_measured_before_freezing.determinant_base_rate: 322 of ~2,893 genomes (about 11%) carry a Subclass-GENTAMICIN determinant

determinant_definition_is_the_DEPLOYED_r.matching: SUBSTRING on the uppercased Subclass, exactly as `curated_determinants_from_main` does -- so GENTAMICIN/KANAMYCIN/TOBRAMYCIN and APRAMYCIN/GENTAMICIN/TOBRAMYCIN COUNT (343 rows, not the 324 that an equality match would give).
determinant_definition_is_the_DEPLOYED_r.why_this_matters: 3,298 of the cohort's aminoglycoside rows are Subclass STREPTOMYCIN (aph(3'')-Ib, aph(6)-Id, aadA). Keying on Class=AMINOGLYCOSIDE instead would swamp the signal and turn this into a result about STREPTOMYCIN co-carriage while still looking like a gentamicin finding.
determinant_definition_is_the_DEPLOYED_r.rescue_is_inert_here: ZERO rmt/npmA rows exist in this cohort -- independently reconfirming the 2026-09-03 Oxford rmt probe. The v2 rescue therefore cannot affect this result in either direction.

verdict_rule.SUPPORTED: determinant-carriage rate is HIGHER among clinically-S/ECOFF-NWT than among clinically-S/ECOFF-WT, AND the observed difference exceeds the MAXIMUM of 1000 permutations that shuffle the WT/NWT label while holding both stratum sizes fixed.
verdict_rule.WEAK_DIRECTIONAL: the direction is right but the difference falls inside the permutation null. Must be reported as NOT established -- never as a partial win.
verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: carriage is equal or LOWER among the ECOFF-NWT stratum -- the predicted ordering fails outright.
verdict_rule.INDETERMINATE: the discriminating stratum falls below 20 isolates, or no drug is SCOREABLE.

why_a_permutation_null_and_not_an_effect: With 25 isolates against ~2,656, any effect-size threshold I picked would be arbitrary -- exactly the mis-specification that sank the two earlier bars. A permutation null on the anchor label self-calibrates to the stratum sizes actually present, so the bar is a CONTROL rather than a guessed number.
declared_in_advance: A SUPPORTED verdict argues the ECOFF is the better anchor FOR THIS DECODER ON THIS COHORT. It is NOT by itself grounds to edit mic_tiers.py -- that is sha256-pinned in the v2 prospective lock, and changing it retires the lock and restarts the prospective clock. That remains a user-authority decision.
One organism, one UK region, 2008-2018, one collapsed MIC panel. Oxford is single-source: it trips G7 and is n/a on G2 for that reason (wiki/oxford_gate_screen_2026-09-11.md).
n=25 is small. A FALSIFIED or WEAK_DIRECTIONAL verdict at this size is weak evidence against the claim, and will be reported as such rather than as a refutation.
The comparison is CARRIAGE, not accuracy. It asks which anchor the genotype agrees with better; it does not establish that either anchor predicts clinical outcome.
